example: Requirement R references definition A. A references B, and B references A. R's evidence contains one definition input for A and one for B. A function attestation whose requirements input selects R also requires both inputs. Dependency collection terminates. Changing B's phrase or body invalidates both records' snapshots of B. {cite}`requirements.definitions.dependencies` {cite}`requirements.definitions.inputs`
